headline: Names a post office in Saugerties, New York, after former Congressman Maurice D. Hinchey.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 111 Market Street in Saugerties, New York. The building will be officially called the "Maurice D. Hinchey Post Office Building." It is an honorary designation and does not change postal services, rules, or fees.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on July 24, 2018, and the name took effect on that date.
